parole.testo: From Coptic ⲕⲗⲁϥⲧ (klaft, “calotte”) or/and from a feminine variant of Classical Syriac ܟܲܠܵܘܵܐ (kalāwā), ܟܲܠܘܵܐ (kalwā, “tiara”). See Latin calautica for more; possibly a doublet of قَلَنْسُوَة (qalansuwa).
